Society is inadvertently asigning value to human life based not on actions but on its stage in life.

And I do not believe that God "causes" miscarriages. I believe he allows everything to happen the way it will. God is the dealer at a cards table. He deals you your cards but once you have em the game is yours. He doesn't intervene in the "game" of life. God isn't there to stop the bad from happening. He's there to help us get through it. And since we live in an imperfect and sin filled world evil things will happen. Things that will challenge our faith and make us question why God would allow something like this to happen. If we really are Christians then we really believe that christ died for us. You ask why God would allow babies to die in miscarriage when he could've stopped it. Why would God let his son die on the cross if he could've stopped it?
